summary: The candidate implements the requested comparison and fixes the reviewed BasevLLMParameter scratch-subclass failure, but it reports a whole module as matching when a checkpoint omits arbitrary live parameters. This leaves a reproducible false-positive counterexample for incomplete checkpoints.

tests.what_was_measured: At recorded base, the original comparison feature is absent and importing compare_module_weights_with_disk raises ImportError.
At exact candidate commit, all six candidate regression tests passed against checkout source.

On AMD Instinct MI350X, a concrete ModelWeightParameter production-style column loader matched an independent CPU reference and detected mutation; independently, a checkpoint omitting one of two live parameters incorrectly returned match=true.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X executed the concrete ModelWeightParameter load, CPU-reference equality check, checksum match, mutation, and mismatch in raw/adversarial_candidate.txt.

remaining_counterexamples: A checkpoint containing only one matching parameter for a module with two live parameters returns match=true while the omitted live parameter can hold an arbitrary stale value; the worker/API consequently claims all requested modules match.
remaining_limitations: FLUX.2-klein and Qwen-Image model weights were unavailable, so model-specific VAE/text-encoder end-to-end serving behavior remains unverified.
Only one GPU was assigned; multi-rank TP/SP/DTensor behavior was not exercised.
The single-rank production-style parallel loader used TP rank zero without a distributed process group.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
